items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: It was partly owned by Kenny Burrel and all the guys would come down because Ron — Ron honored me by kind of liking what I did, just played tunes together.

ctx.x: And there was a club on the west side called The Guitar. And Ron asked me to do it with him. So it was just me and him in this little club. It was partly owned by Kenny Burrel and all the guys would come down because Ron — Ron honored me by kind of liking what I did, just played tunes together. And I think he recommended me for a lot of things. Right now I’m working for him at City College teaching in his jazz program up there. And what was the question?
The question was talking about Wayne Shorter.
